name: ColorFittings Carbon Fiber Display Case
title: ColorFittings Carbon Fiber Display Case
description:
The ColorFittings Carbon Fiber Display Case is engineered for high-demand automotive fluid systems. Showcase the Original Colored AN Fittings with the official ColorFittings 7-Color Display Case. Designed for dealers, vendors, and performance shops, this premium shadow box features all seven of the signature anodized colors mounted against a high-gloss carbon fiber backing for a clean, motorsport-inspired presentation.

Each display is professionally assembled to highlight the depth, finish, and precision machining of the CNC 6061-T6 billet aluminum fittings. The carbon fiber background enhances contrast and makes each color pop, creating an eye-catching retail or showroom centerpiece that instantly communicates quality and performance.

Perfect for:

Performance shops and speed stores

Automotive dealerships

Race teams and fabrication shops

Trade show booths and vendor displays

Garage or showroom wall décor

Built to elevate your retail presence, this ColorFittings shadow box display helps customers see and compare all seven anodized color options in person — making purchase decisions easier and increasing upsell opportunities.

Complete your display setup with the full line of AN fittings, braided hose, and assembly tools to bring the full ColorFittings experience to your customers.

Technical Specifications:
• Origin: Precision CNC-machined in the USA.
• Material & Finish: 6061-T6 Billet Aluminum with hard anodized protective finish.
